description: JSON output of grid brain changes --json; internal/braincmd/changes.go:188-190, rows of internal/brain/changes.go Change, newest first. The app reads every field (internal/slices/brainchanges/http.go, internal/slices/brain/vault_more.go).

changes.description: The brain's audit rows, newest first; an empty array when the brain has none.

at.description: When the change was logged, in the contract time layout.

status.description: What was done to the note, for example created, edited or dropped.

hash.description: sha256: and the 16 hex digits of the note's rev.

origin_kind.description: Who made the change: person or session.

reason.description: The reason given for the change; empty when none.

title: grid brain changes output
